lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Macal, I'm not raising the rent because I want to. The building costs more now.
lines.direction: apologetic but firm, South Asian accent

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I understand. But if you raise it now, I might have to move. I've been here two years.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Two years, yes. But there's one more thing. Your visa paperwork — it needs renewing soon.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: How soon?

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Ninety days. If the papers aren't ready by then, I can't keep you here.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا يَا جَمَاعَة! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَإِنْتَ مَعَ يَلَّا فْلُوَنْت... النَّهَارْدَه مَعَالْ بِيُوَاجِهْ مُشْكِلَة كَبِيرَة: الإِيجَارْ غَلِي، وَالْفِيزَا لَهَا تِسْعِين يَوْم... بَسْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: اسْمَعْ كَوَيِّس الْجُمْلَة دِي: I understand, but... — دِي بْتَفْتَحْ أَي مُفَاوَضَة بِأَدَب، مِشْ بِخُنَاقَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَتَانِي جُمْلَة: if you raise it, I might... — لَاحِظْ إِنَّ 'مَايْتْ' مِشْ وَعْد، دِي احْتِمَال... وِالْاحْتِمَال بِيِدِّي مَجَالْ لِلْكَلَام.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا، نِسْمَعْ مَعَالْ بِيِتَفَاوَضْ إِزَّاي... وَخُدْ بَالَكْ مِنْ كَلِمَة by then — مَعْنَاهَا 'لِحَدّ سَاعِتْهَا'. يَلَّا!
lines.direction: playful, encouraging, ready to dive in

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Ninety days. If the papers aren't ready by then, I can't keep you here. I'm sorry, Macal. This is not personal.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I know it's not personal. But this is a lot at once. The rent, and now the visa. Can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Of course. Ask.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: If I sort out the visa paperwork myself, would you hold the old rent for three more months? I mean, just until I renew.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Hmm. Three months is a long time. But I like you, Macal. You pay on time, and you never make trouble.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I live here since two years, and I've never missed a payment. If you give me the time, I'll get the papers done. I promise.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Two months. Not three. And if the paperwork is late, we talk again. Fair?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Fair. Two months. Thank you, Mr. Qureshi. I won't waste it.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Good. Start with the medical test. That one takes the longest. And Macal — don't wait until the last week.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I won't. I'll start tomorrow. Thanks again.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Inshallah it all works out. Goodnight, Macal.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّبْ يَا جَمَاعَة، نِشُوفْ مَعَالْ بِيِتَفَاوَضْ إِزَّاي... لَاحِظْ أَوَّلْ جُمْلَة: I know it's not personal, but... دِي بْتَعْتَرِفْ بِوَجْهَة نَظَرْ الطَّرَفْ التَّانِي، وِبَعْدِينْ بِتَحُطّْ طَلَبَكْ. يَعْنِي: I know it's not personal, but I need more time.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَالْجُمْلَة التَّانْيَة: If you give me the time, I'll get the papers done. دِي شَرْطْ — الشَّرْطْ بِـ if، وِالنَّتِيجَة بِـ I'll. وِدِي أَقْوَى طَرِيقَة تِفَاوُضْ بِأَدَب: إِنْتَ تِدِّي، أَنَا أَعْمَلْ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَخُدْ بَالَكْ: would you hold the old rent? — كَلِمَة would هِنَا بِتَخَلِّي الطَّلَبْ مُؤَدَّبْ، زِي مَا تِقُولْ 'يَا رِيتْ' بِالْمَصْرِي.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: ...بَسْ فِيهْ غَلْطَة مَعَالْ عَمَلْهَا: قَالْ I live here since two years. الْمَشْكِلَة إِنَّ كَلِمَة since بِتْيِيجِي مَعَ الْفِعْلْ فِي الْمَاضِي الْكَامِلْ: I have lived here since two years... لَأْ! بِالْأَمْرِيكِي الطَّبِيعِي: I have lived here for two years — بِـ for مِشْ since.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَعَالْ نِتْمَرَّنْ عَلَى صَوْتْ النَّهَارْدَه: Schwa — الْـ 'أَ' الْخَفِيفَة الْكَسْلَانَة. زِي فِي about: مِشْ a-bout، لَأْ — uh-bout. وِفِي الْمُشْكِلَة بْتَاعْتِنَا، كَلِمَة paper... الْمَقْطَعْ الثَّانِي بِيِخْتَفِي: pay-puh، مِشْ pay-per. يَلَّا كَرَّرْ مَعَايَا: about... paper... visa... beautiful!
lines.direction: playful, energetic drill, slow on examples

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: So? How did it go with Mr. Qureshi? You look like you just ran a marathon.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Almost. He agreed to hold the rent for two months. But only if I finish the visa paperwork before that. I've been here for two years, Nour, and now everything depends on ninety days.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Two months? That's actually good. You just need the medical test and the offer letter, right?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: The medical test, yes. But here's the problem. For the renewal, they need a full-time offer. Dune and Co. hasn't given me one yet. I'm still... contract to contract.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Wait. So you have the time now, but not the paper that actually keeps you here?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Exactly. If I don't get that offer by then, the two months mean nothing. I bought time, Nour. I didn't buy my future.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Then we go get it. The fellowship interview is in three weeks. If you win it, maybe that changes everything for Dune.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: If I win it. That's a big if. But you're right. I've lived here for two years. I'm not going to lose it sitting still.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Good. Because I just checked your calendar. Your interview slot? They moved it up. It's Friday.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Friday? Nour, that's... that's four days from now. I haven't even prepared.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّبْ يَا جَمَاعَة، نِلَخِّصْ بِسُرْعَة... I know it's not personal, but I need more time — دِي تِفَاوُضْ بِأَدَبْ. If you give me the time, I'll get the papers done — شَرْطْ وِنَتِيجَة. وَ would you hold the old rent? — طَلَبْ مُؤَدَّبْ زِي 'يَا رِيتْ'. وَمَتْنَسَاشْ: I have lived here FOR two years، مِشْ since!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الْحَلَقَة النَّهَارْدَه هِيَّ... If you give me the time, I'll get it done. جُمْلَة وَاحْدَة، تِفْتَحْ بِهَا أَيِّ تَفَاوُضْ، مَعَ اللَانْدْلُورْدْ، مَعَ الْمُدِيرْ، مَعَ أَيِّ حَدْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دِلْوَقْتِي أَنَا عَايِزْ أَسْمَعْ صَوْتَكْ! سَجِّلْ فُويْسْ نُوتْ صُغَيَّرْ، قُولْ فِيهْ الْعِبَارَة بِصَوْتْ عَالِي وَوَاضِحْ، وَرَكِّزْ عَلَى الصَّوْتْ الْخَفِيفْ — about، paper، beautiful.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَابْعَتُوا لِي عَلَى تِلِيجْرَامْ، فِي مَجْمُوعَة Empire English Community. إِحْنَا هِنِسْمَعْكُمْ، وِهِنسَجِّعْكُمْ وَاحِدْ وَاحِدْ... مِشْ وَاجِبْ، دِي عِيلَة!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا، مَعَالْ عِنْدُهْ أَرْبَعْ أَيَّامْ بَسْ... وِإِنْتَ كَمَانْ عِنْدَكْ فُرْصَة تِتْمَرَّنْ النَّهَارْدَه. أَشُوفْكُمْ فِي الْحَلَقَة الْجَايَة. يَلَّا فْلُوِنْتْ!

phrase_of_episode.en: If you give me the time, I'll get it done.

phonetic_focus.note: The lazy, unstressed 'uh' vowel - the most common sound in English. 'about' -> 'uh-bout', 'sofa' -> 'sof-uh'. Unstressed syllables shrink to schwa.
